Donations are tax deductible and we need your support to continue our work. Text-to-donate, text VSRF to 53-555.Show more In a special Tuesday edition of VSRF Live for the Thanksgiving week, we're thrilled to welcome back our good friend Dr. Brian Hooker, Chief Scientific Officer at Children’s Health Defense (CHD).
Dr. Hooker will introduce one of CHD’s most important projects to date: The COVID Index — a comprehensive, searchable database of the science and evidence that was censored or suppressed regarding SARS-CoV-2, the lockdowns, and the COVID-19 injections.
For years, government agencies, the public-health establishment, Big Tech, and corporate media have worked in lockstep to bury anything that contradicted the official "COVID Narrative," the manufactured consensus we were told to believe. Legitimate research disappeared. Experts were silenced. Inconvenient facts were branded “misinformation” to shield government-sanctioned disinformation.
This is why CHD created The COVID Index — the world’s largest, dynamic directory of censored science and suppressed evidence on COVID-19.
The Index gathers thousands of studies, articles, datasets, expert testimonies, and whistleblower accounts that exposed the truth about the virus, the lockdowns, and the injections. It’s what the actual science revealed all along. At the same time, the Index documents the flawed, fraudulent, and cherry-picked “science” deliberately amplified to sustain a COVID Narrative that divided families, wrecked economies, and caused irreparable harm.
Tuesday night, Dr. Hooker will give us a live tour of the Index, show exactly how to use it, and explain why it’s now an indispensable tool for anyone seeking the evidence the establishment spent years trying to erase.
You won’t want to miss this special Thanksgiving-week episode — TUESDAY at 7 PM ET. Show less
